title: Reports say OpenAI's ChatGPT Mac app stored conversations in unencrypted text files
summary: The AI Incident Database logs reports that the macOS app saved user data without encryption.

title: Reports say British female politicians were targeted with deepfake pornography
summary: British female politicians were reportedly victims of deepfake pornographic images.

title: Figma disables an AI design feature after accusations that it copied Apple's Weather app
summary: Figma switched the feature off after the accusations.

title: Deepfake video falsely says Ukraine's first lady Olena Zelenska bought a luxury car; reports tie it to a Russian-linked campaign
summary: The AI Incident Database describes the video as part of a Russian-linked disinformation campaign.

title: Report alleges UK Department for Work and Pensions AI systems discriminate against single mothers
summary: The allegation concerns automated systems used by the DWP.

title: Reuters reports committee members ask for a US government review of G42's foreign ties over the Microsoft investment
summary: The Microsoft stake was later structured with added oversight provisions.

title: EU AI Act is published in the Official Journal of the European Union
summary: The Artificial Intelligence Act was published in the Official Journal on 12 July 2024.

title: Reports say xAI's Grok produced misleading headlines and amplified unverified claims after the Trump assassination attempt
summary: The AI Incident Database logs reports that Grok spread unverified claims about the event.

title: Baidu's Apollo Go robotaxi runs manned tests in 11 cities and plans driverless tests in five
summary: Chinese Wikipedia says the manned test service covered 11 cities, with fully driverless testing planned in Beijing, Wuhan, Chongqing, Shenzhen and Shanghai.

title: Reports allege Google's Gemini read Google Drive files without explicit user consent
summary: The AI Incident Database logs allegations that Gemini accessed users' Drive files without clear permission.

title: New York Times report: 55 of 98 homicide victims reviewed had been scored low or negligible risk by Spain's VioGen algorithm
summary: The report describes a woman who was killed after the police risk-assessment algorithm rated her risk low.

title: Meta releases Llama 3.1 in 8B, 70B and 405B sizes
summary: Meta released the Llama 3.1 family on 23 July 2024.

title: Mistral AI announces Mistral Large 2, a 123-billion-parameter model with a 128,000-token context
summary: Weights for the model were later released on Hugging Face.

title: Google DeepMind's AlphaProof and AlphaGeometry 2 solve four of six International Mathematical Olympiad problems
summary: The combined result reached silver-medal level, the first time an AI system reached medal level at the competition.

title: Reports say a deepfake of Kamala Harris making damaging comments circulated on X and was amplified by Elon Musk
summary: The AI Incident Database logs the deepfake and its amplification on X.

title: UN General Assembly adopts by consensus a China-proposed resolution on international cooperation for AI capacity building
summary: The UN General Assembly adopted without a vote the China-led resolution on enhancing international cooperation for AI capacity building, aimed especially at developing countries, China Daily reported.

title: Brazil's data protection authority ANPD orders Meta to suspend use of Brazilian users' personal data to train AI models
summary: The ANPD issued a preventive measure suspending Meta's new privacy policy that allowed personal data from its platforms to be used for training generative AI, with a daily fine for non-compliance.

title: Japan's Ministry of Defense publishes its first basic policy on promoting AI use, naming seven priority areas
summary: Japan's Defense Ministry released a basic policy on AI use covering priority areas such as target detection and identification, intelligence analysis and command and control, while keeping human responsibility.

title: World AI Conference and High-Level Meeting on Global AI Governance issue the Shanghai Declaration on Global AI Governance, Xinhua reports
summary: The 2024 World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai issued a declaration calling for AI development, safety, governance and international cooperation, including support for developing countries.

title: SenseTime releases SenseNova 5.5 and its multimodal real-time model SenseNova 5o at the World AI Conference
summary: SenseTime unveiled its SenseNova 5.5 large model series, including the streaming multimodal SenseNova 5o, at WAIC 2024 in Shanghai.

title: Argentina's Security Ministry creates an AI unit (UIAAS) that will patrol open social media and use AI to predict crimes
summary: A resolution published in the Official Bulletin set up the Unit of Artificial Intelligence Applied to Security, tasked with monitoring open social networks, analysing camera images in real time and predicting future crimes; unions and rights groups raised surveillance concerns.

title: Brazil presents a national AI plan with about USD 4 billion (23 billion reais) in planned investment, including a supercomputer
summary: Brazil's government presented the Brazilian Artificial Intelligence Plan 2024-2028, which foresees about 23 billion reais for AI infrastructure, a public supercomputer, national models and public-service applications.
